[Intro]
[Verse]
Dusty boots upon the porch swing
Watching fireflies dance in the grass
The crickets hum a low melody
As the golden hours slowly pass
[Pre-Chorus]
The moon is a silver coin
Tossed across the velvet sky
[Chorus]
You are the heartbeat in my chest
The steady hand inside my own
In every breath and every light
You make this house feel like home

The secrets whispered in the dark
Your hand finds mine in the shadows
Igniting every tiny spark

No more searching for the way
Just staying right where we belong
[Chorus]
You are the heartbeat in my chest
The steady hand inside my own
In every breath and every light
You make this house feel like home
[Outro]
